item.title: West Haven hockey wins on the road against Daniel Hand, 6-1
item.description: MADISON, Conn. (WTNH) -- Daniel Hand High School hosted West Haven High School for some ice hockey action Monday. Multiple Blue Devils scored goals Monday, including Connor Moriarty, who recorded one from an assist by Luca Dilegge. West Haven returned home with a win, 6-1.

item.title: Waterbury high school student among 2 dead after multi-vehicle crash on I-84
item.description: Two people died after a Sunday morning crash that closed Interstate 84 West in Waterbury. The deceased driver was a 16-year-old Waterbury high school student.

item.title: Police ID Pawtucket shooter; 2 killed, 3 hospitalized
item.description: The 56-year-old father of a North Providence High School senior opened fire at his son’s hockey game on Monday, killing two family members and injuring others.
